summary: The de-minimal and de-supported decision environments rename plugins (old names deprecated but still work); for example change the ansible.eda.pg_listener source to eda.builtin.pg_listener in rulebooks (AAP-48005).
questions: Do I need to rename event sources in my rulebooks?

answer_card.title: Renamed EDA event sources
answer_card.answer_md:
Decision environments `de-minimal` and `de-supported` use new plugin names; the old names still work but are deprecated. Update the source in rulebooks, for example:

```yaml
sources:
  - eda.builtin.pg_listener:   # was ansible.eda.pg_listener
      postgres_params:
        host: postgresql_hostname
      channels:
        - my_events
```
